text: For months, they had held the peninsula—as planned.
Bataan… and Corregidor… waiting for a relief that never came.
The Navy could not reach them. No reinforcements would arrive.
Still, they fought—four months against an enemy better supplied, better fed, and never ordered to yield.

speaker: General King
text: How much longer can we hold on…
The order had been clear: Hold
But what remained… could no longer do so.
Soon, a decision would be made
one that defied orders, but spared what lives could still be saved.
He still believed they were holding on
he would soon be the one to end it.
